text_ar:
و حَدَّثَنِي عَنْ مَالِك عَنْ نَافِعٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ
كَانَ يَتَيَمَّمُ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ
text_ar_search:
و حدثني عن مالك عن نافع أن عبد الله بن عمر
كان يتيمم إلى المرفقين
text_en:
Yahya related to me from Malik from Nafi that Abdullah ibn Umar
used to do tayammum up to his elbows.


Malik was asked about
how tayammum was done and what parts were covered and he said, "Strike
the ground once for the face and once for the arms and wipe them to
the elbows."
text_id: Telah menceritakan kepadaku dari Malik dari [Nafi'] bahwa [Abdullah bin Umar] bertayamum hingga ke siku-sikunya.
